capabilities: Schedule whole-note reviews on a fixed interval ladder
Grade reviews with four buttons and set the next date
Pull reviews in before an exam date and cram the deck
Show review board, forecast chart and progress table
Create review notes from a template and enroll notes in bulk
disambiguation: Not a flashcard plugin; it schedules reviews of entire notes and stores all review state in each note's frontmatter.
extras: UI is Japanese only; English UI is planned. Free and open source (MIT), no network requests. Review state lives in study-* frontmatter keys, so it syncs with the notes; grading the same note on two devices at once can cause a sync conflict. Status-bar review count is desktop only.
intentEvidence: Other plugins such as Spaced Repetition (flashcards and entire notes) and Note Review Reminder (spaced reviews and reminders) also schedule note reviews.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule and track reviews of whole notes over time, so notes you want to memorize are never revisited on a spaced schedule.

relations.evidence: Other plugins such as Spaced Repetition (flashcards and entire notes) and Note Review Reminder (spaced reviews and reminders) also schedule note reviews.

There is no separate database, so a note shows when it is due next, and Dataview can read it.
The due-date and final-review rules stay inside the plugin, so templates (Templater and so on) don't need to copy them.

summary: Spaced-review plugin that schedules whole-note reviews on a fixed Ebbinghaus interval ladder, with optional exam-date cramming and review state kept in note frontmatter.
